params.prompt: A believable, quietly energetic home unboxing with the registered Tasso+ product as the hero. Product placement must preserve the EXACT supplied official product photograph: compact palm-sized off-white teardrop shell; broad round top tapering to a narrow bottom; a LARGE raised coral-red circular button occupying most of the upper front, with its shallow curved Tasso emblem; wide off-white rim especially below the button; tiny bottom connector. DEVICE ALONE, AS PHOTOGRAPHED: no attached long tube or vial, no lights or screen, no shiny generic gadget redesign. This is a real small object about two finger-widths wide, not a palm-filling puck. Respect its precise button-to-shell proportions and emblem in every view. The additional scene image is ONLY the color/soft-glow reference, never a product reference. REIMAGINE THE SCENE: an adult woman in a plain ivory exercise top at a lived-in pale wooden table after a morning walk. Frame cropped collarbone to hands; no talking face or lip-sync. One modest off-white cardboard box with simple pale paper insert, one glass of water, linen cloth. Natural imperfect skin, creased fabric, paper fibers and tactile matte plastic. A single continuous handheld photographic take, elevated three-quarter view looking into the box; normal real-time movement and tiny human camera corrections. 0–2 seconds: one hand steadies the box while the other opens its lid fully in one fluid everyday gesture, immediately revealing the reference Tasso+ lying face up. 2–4 seconds: fingers grasp its WHITE SIDES without pressing the red button, lift it out naturally. 4–7 seconds: she brings it a little toward the camera, front clearly visible and bottom connector downward, wrist turns only about15degrees, the large red button and embossed emblem stay plainly readable. The camera follows her hand smoothly with a modest lean forward, not a slow cinematic crawl. 7–10 seconds: she returns the same rigid device face-up into its insert naturally. 10–12 seconds: her hand leaves the open box and reaches casually toward the glass as the camera settles on the revealed product. No action stretched into slow motion, no frozen hand hovering, no time ramp, no hard cut or invented object. Keep the approved rich CORAL-PEACH light bloom along pale clothing/skin and VIOLET shadows/reflections, fine analog film grain and gentle optical softness. Skin and cardboard still feel photographic and tactile; the device retains clear contours and actual red/ivory identity beneath the same lighting. Background subtly defocused, product sharp enough to recognize, no heavy blur hiding mistakes. The optical treatment should resemble the supplied reference throughout, without melting skin, white clipping or neon plasma. Silent video for a webpage. No subtitles, captions, CTA, voiceover, product use on skin, button press, needle, blood or added logos.
